title: How to Connect Business Central MCP to Claude Desktop
summary: The post explains how to set up Business Central's native MCP server with Claude Desktop by registering an Entra application, enabling the MCP server in Business Central, and configuring mcp-remote to bridge the connection. This helps AI agents like Claude access Business Central data through a desktop client.
key_points: Business Central's native MCP server launched in 2025 release wave 2, enabling third-party AI agents to access BC data
Claude Desktop requires an Entra app registration with a public client setup using PKCE and a specific OAuth callback URI
The mcp-remote bridge tool handles HTTP transport and Microsoft sign-in between Claude Desktop and the BC MCP server
Configuration requires matching values across three parts: Entra registration, BC MCP server setup, and Claude Desktop config file
Three common pitfalls: confusing Claude Code config with Desktop config, using outdated mcp-remote versions, and incorrect callback port settings

quotes.text: Claude Desktop signs into Business Central through Microsoft Entra, so we need an app registration.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the foundational requirement for securing the connection between Claude Desktop and Business Central
